A woman wears a badge depicting Ahmaud Arbery as she watches the trial of William "Roddie" Bryan, Travis McMichael and Gregory McMichael, charged with the February 2020 death of 25-year-old Ahmaud Arbery, in Brunswick, Georgia #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: REUTERS/Marco Bello https://t.co/HLOTkm4BY1

A man plays a saxophone during a vigil for Ahmaud Arbery outside the Glynn county courthouse in Brunswick, Georgia, as jury deliberates whether Greg McMichael, his son, Travis McMichael, and William Bryan murdered him #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: REUTERS/Marco Bello

Verdict: GUILTY https://t.co/EsobGz8VjU

Ahmaud Arbery's father Marcus Arbery, center, his hugged by his attorney Benjamin Crump after the jury convicted his murderers in the Glynn County Courthouse in Brunswick, Georgia #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: AP Photo/Stephen B. Morton, Pool https://t.co/UEwVLynIWu

A woman holds a sign outside the Glynn County Courthouse after the jury reached a guilty verdict in the trial of the men charged with the February 2020 death of 25-year-old Ahmaud Arbery, in Brunswick, Georgia #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: REUTERS/Marco Bello https://t.co/EkRCUKjAsE

People attend a celebration of life event for Casey Goodson Jr., a year after the 23-year-old Black man was shot in the back five times by former Franklin County Sheriff's Deputy Jason Meade as he entered his home, in Columbus, Ohio #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: REUTERS/Gaelen Morse https://t.co/CN6084nNHr

People console each other at a demonstration as opening statements begin in the trial of a former police officer over the shooting of Daunte Wright in Hennepin, Minneapolis #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: AP Photo/Christian Monterrosa https://t.co/QWdcwM6wfR

A person demonstrates in support of Daunte Wright in Minneapolis, Minnesota, during jury deliberations in the manslaughter trial of former police officer Kim Potter #BlackLivesMatter
Credit: Kerem Yucel/AFP via Getty Images https://t.co/Olj527way1
